name: SC-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with R+21 partisan lean
Incumbent Sheri Biggs running with large fundraising edge
Minimal Democratic resources and no outside spending
model.rationale: The district's R+21 lean, Biggs's incumbency and dominant fundraising advantage, and Polymarket pricing near 94% for Republicans all point to a safe Republican hold, with no evidence suggesting movement toward the Democrat.
model.watch: Any late polling or unexpected outside spending in the district would be the first sign this is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
South Carolina's 3rd District is a deeply Republican seat, with a partisan lean of about 21 points toward the GOP. First-term incumbent Sheri Biggs was renominated without difficulty and holds a large financial edge, having raised over half a million dollars against roughly $41,000 for Democrat Eunice Lehmacher, who has minimal cash on hand and no outside support. A Libertarian is also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on fundamentals, which point to a comfortable Republican win in the high teens. Prediction markets similarly price a Biggs victory at roughly 94 percent. The race remains a safe Republican hold with little competitive activity to date.
